name: better-files
description: Embeddable data rooms for TypeScript apps on Better IAM: rooms, folders, permission matrices, guests, secure viewing and audit, mounted into Next.js, NestJS, Express and more.

name: @better-files/adapter-drizzle
description: Drizzle adapter for Better Files: run on the host's drizzle db (node-postgres, postgres.js, PGlite, better-sqlite3, libSQL), with a generated schema for drizzle-kit

name: @better-files/adapter-libsql
description: libSQL / Turso database adapter for Better Files.

name: @better-files/adapter-pglite
description: PGlite (embedded PostgreSQL in WebAssembly) adapter for Better Files: local development, tests, edge and in-browser Postgres

name: @better-files/adapter-postgres
description: PostgreSQL database adapter for Better Files, via pg.

name: @better-files/adapter-prisma
description: Prisma adapter for Better Files: run on the host's PrismaClient (PostgreSQL or SQLite), with generated models so prisma migrate owns the tables

name: @better-files/adapter-sql
description: Shared SQL implementation of the Better Files database adapter: schema migrations, filters and transactions over a small driver interface.

name: @better-files/adapter-sqlite
description: SQLite database adapter for Better Files, via better-sqlite3.

name: @better-files/cli
description: The better-files command line: migrate, maintain, verify, doctor, openapi and generate for a host's instance, and sync to mirror a room to a local folder

name: @better-files/client
description: Browser-safe typed client for Better Files: calls, a parallel resumable uploader, and download links.

name: @better-files/core
description: Browser-safe core of Better Files: capabilities, the permission resolver, the schema model, adapter ports and the plugin contract.

name: @better-files/crypto
description: Streaming authenticated encryption (AES-256-GCM segments), key providers and signed tokens for Better Files.

name: @better-files/iam
description: Better IAM integration for Better Files: the IAM plugin (actions and resource types), identity and authorization providers, and the resource resolver.

name: @better-files/jobs
description: Queue runners for Better Files jobs: BullMQ and pg-boss, with Better Files keeping retries, backoff and recovery in its own jobs table.

name: @better-files/kms
description: Bring-your-own-key providers for Better Files: AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS, Azure Key Vault and HashiCorp Vault Transit over fetch (no SDKs), plus key migration between providers.

name: @better-files/mcp
description: Model Context Protocol tools for Better Files: let AI agents browse, search, read and ask questions of data rooms with the caller's permissions

name: @better-files/middleware
description: Framework integrations for Better Files: Express, Hono, Fastify, Koa, React Router, h3 and framework-neutral request helpers.

name: @better-files/nestjs
description: NestJS integration for Better Files: a module that serves the protocol, a capability guard and decorators.

name: @better-files/next
description: Next.js App Router integration for Better Files: route handlers, server-side calls and page guards.

name: @better-files/plugin-ai
description: Permission-aware AI for Better Files: answers and summaries grounded in documents the asker may view, with citations, on Claude.

name: @better-files/plugin-analytics
description: Engagement analytics for Better Files: views and downloads by person, team and document, and who has not opened what.

name: @better-files/plugin-annotations
description: Annotations for Better Files: page-anchored notes and highlights on documents, private, shared with your group, or room-wide, with replies and resolution

name: @better-files/plugin-audit
description: Audit reports for Better Files: participants, the access matrix by group and folder, engagement per person and activity-chain integrity, as JSON or a PDF for closing binders and access reviews

name: @better-files/plugin-connectors
description: Cloud drive imports for Better Files: Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive/SharePoint and Box into a room, with folder structure, re-import of changes and progress

name: @better-files/plugin-esign
description: Native e-signature for Better Files: envelopes, sequential or parallel signing links, an evidence chain and a certificate of completion.

name: @better-files/plugin-guard
description: Download rate limits and anomaly reporting for Better Files, wired to Better IAM threat detection and response.

name: @better-files/plugin-inbound
description: Email to a data room for Better Files: per-folder drop addresses whose attachments become documents, with sender allow-lists, expiry and provider authentication (Postmark adapter included)

name: @better-files/plugin-links
description: Dropbox-style share links for Better Files: passwords, email capture, expiry, use caps and full activity logging.

name: @better-files/plugin-nda
description: Per-room NDA gating for Better Files: versioned agreements, hash-bound acceptances, and content withheld until accepted.

name: @better-files/plugin-network
description: Network rules for Better Files: per-room IP allow-lists for guests or everyone, enforced on every operation and download.

name: @better-files/plugin-notifications
description: Email notifications and daily digests for Better Files, with per-room preferences.

name: @better-files/plugin-processing
description: Document processing for Better Files: Office to PDF (LibreOffice or your converter) so every format can be viewed and watermarked, plus thumbnails

name: @better-files/plugin-qa
description: Due-diligence Q&A for Better Files: ask, assign, answer, approve and publish, with team-scoped visibility.

name: @better-files/plugin-quotas
description: Storage quotas for Better Files: byte, document and file-size limits per room and per tenant (from your plan), enforced before upload, with usage and warnings

name: @better-files/plugin-redaction
description: Redaction for Better Files: find sensitive text (emails, phone numbers, IDs, your patterns) and burn it out of PDFs and images as a new version or a redacted copy

name: @better-files/plugin-retention
description: Legal holds for Better Files: preserve rooms or folders against deletion, trash purges and room deletion.

name: @better-files/plugin-reviews
description: Access reviews for Better Files: periodic room access certifications with per-person keep or revoke decisions, recommendations from activity, self-review prevention, scheduled campaigns and revocation on completion

name: @better-files/plugin-scan
description: Virus scanning for Better Files uploads: a ClamAV (clamd INSTREAM) client and quarantine until clean.

name: @better-files/plugin-search
description: Search for Better Files: names and (opt-in) document text, filtered by the caller's permissions.

name: @better-files/plugin-sync
description: Delta sync for Better Files: snapshots and a permission-aware changes feed with content hashes, for desktop and CLI mirrors

name: @better-files/plugin-tasks
description: Checklists and tasks for Better Files: assignees, due dates, linked documents and overdue events.

name: @better-files/plugin-templates
description: Room templates for Better Files: folder skeletons, groups, settings and checklists, built-in and per tenant.

name: @better-files/plugin-watermark
description: Watermarked downloads and views for Better Files: identity, time and a forensic code stamped on PDFs and images.

name: @better-files/plugin-webhooks
description: Signed, retried webhooks for Better Files events, with SSRF protection.

name: @better-files/react
description: React bindings for Better Files: a provider, typed query hooks, an uploader hook and a capability gate.

name: @better-files/server
description: The Better Files engine: the betterFiles() factory, the two-layer access engine, plugin host and HTTP protocol.

name: @better-files/storage-azure
description: Azure Blob Storage adapter for Better Files over fetch, with Shared Key, SAS and Entra ID auth; no Azure SDK.

name: @better-files/storage-cluster
description: A storage control plane for Better Files: servers with local disks join as storage nodes; placement, replication, failover reads, drain and repair, exposed as a StorageAdapter

name: @better-files/storage-fs
description: Local-disk storage adapter for Better Files, with multipart uploads.

name: @better-files/storage-gcs
description: Google Cloud Storage adapter for Better Files over the JSON API and fetch, with service-account tokens and V4 signed URLs; no Google SDK.

name: @better-files/storage-node
description: The storage node agent for Better Files clusters: serves encrypted objects from a local disk, joins and heartbeats to the control plane (outbound), and runs its commands

name: @better-files/storage-regional
description: Data residency for Better Files: routes each room's files to the storage adapter of its region.

name: @better-files/storage-s3
description: S3-compatible storage adapter for Better Files (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, B2, Wasabi) using SigV4 over fetch, no AWS SDK.

name: @better-files/svelte
description: Svelte bindings for Better Files: typed stores for rooms, folders, capabilities and uploads (Svelte 4 and 5, no runtime dependency), plus SvelteKit hooks

name: @better-files/testing
description: In-memory database and storage adapters and a fake identity integration for testing Better Files.

name: @better-files/viewer
description: Secure document viewer for Better Files: server-rendered, watermarked page images and the <bf-viewer> custom element

name: @better-files/vue
description: Vue bindings for Better Files: a plugin and typed composables for rooms, folders, capabilities and uploads
